title: The Painted Cave
text: The walls of this cave are covered in paintings in red, black and ochre: hunts, battles, the founding of the city. At the back, still wet, the newest painting shows your own party exactly as you are, walking into a cave.

options.label: The wisest studies the newest painting to learn what comes next.

outcomes.text: It shows most of what lies ahead. The last part is not yet painted.

options.label: Paint something of your own on the wall among the old marks.

outcomes.text: It feels like a promise kept, though no one can say to whom.

options.label: Scratch out your own picture and refuse whatever it foretold.

outcomes.text: Whatever was going to happen does not.
